data.narrative:
Exodys Energy is a Seed-stage nuclear energy company founded by Carl Perez and Jean-Christophe Piroux that has raised $10M or more to date. The nuclear energy sector includes 11 identifiable comparables: 3 public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private firms, among which Nano Nuclear Energy, Helion, Oklo, Valar Atomics, and X-Energy represent the most relevant peers.

Stage-progression methodology is the applicable valuation approach given data constraints. Using total capital raised ($10M) as a baseline proxy and applying a standard 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to next-stage financing produces an implied valuation of $25M. Peer-median triangulation is not viable; while six same-sector comparables exist, fewer than three meet narrow stage, adjacent-stage, or valuation-tier criteria necessary for reliable benchmarking without introducing bias.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $21M to $29M, with a median estimate of $25M. This reflects application of a single credible method with inherent limitations. Key uncertainties include the absence of a sufficient narrowly-filtered comparable set to validate or adjust the stage-progression result, and reliance on total raised as a valuation proxy rather than discrete financing round prices. Material data on Exodys' technology differentiation, development milestones, and burn rate would improve precision of this assessment.
